candidate_choice: full_s0 is fixed before any new optimizer step: it supplies the recorded L3 adjacent-budget target example, has three false-feasible starts in v7, and all 18 actual primary train cases are feasible. This is a mechanism pilot, not a best-model or development selection.

fit.rule: Use the unchanged stratified squared regression and unchanged component/joint sign targets. Numeric Adam runs at most 300 steps and must pass the original separate old/new numeric checks before boundary fitting; otherwise hold, never force a transition. Boundary uses plain SGD without momentum, retains the numerical gradient, projects only the sign component opposing it, and caps correction to at most 0.25 of the regression norm without amplifying a small sign gradient. This bounds only the first-order sampled-MSE direction, not finite-step metrics. Stop at the first unchanged full train pass. Review original numeric metrics every 10 boundary steps and stop on regression; no rollback, retry, stage quota transfer or restart. Save stages, every start prediction and classification changes. Keep all failed results.

train_gate: Directly call the unchanged v5 train_gate for the pilot's 90 old plus 72 additional train episodes after every step. Separate old/new relative MAE<=0.35 and required Pearson>=0.70, original primary recognition, beta=0, zero false-feasible and selected boundary signs remain mandatory. Do not change any target or label.
pilot_acceptance: The source and pilot actor/other five models remain unchanged. Report numerical checks, false-feasible/false-infeasible and selected signs together. A pilot pass is only the fixed candidate's original complete train pass; lower error or fewer false-feasible alone is partial progress. Failure or insufficient evidence holds the pilot; it cannot be called NAV-065 scientific pass.
downstream: Never call development or produce a deployment bundle in this pilot, even on success. Any six-candidate expansion needs a separately reviewed bounded registration; all six unchanged train gates, saved/reloaded models and the original development/G4 are still required before NAV-066.
failure_policy: A separately approved, pinned one-candidate run only. Proposed settings are not permission for optimizer steps. Nonfinite loss/gradient/parameter stops with evidence; preserve source, stage/final checkpoints and logs. No new rollouts, source/intermediate selection, automatic continuation/expansion, quota transfer, relaxed gates, budget_selection/final access or protected edits.
